items.description: Confirm the current branch and announce it before release work begins.
items.evidence: Development_AVR128DA48 was announced, audited, and frozen before its exact v2.0.3 candidate was integrated.

items.description: Confirm the working tree is clean or that unrelated changes are intentionally excluded.
items.evidence: The candidate and integrated main worktrees were clean; generated build outputs remained ignored.

items.description: Record whether this is a stable release or an explicitly approved prerelease.
items.evidence: The owner requested the established full GitHub release, and v2.0.3 was published as stable.

items.description: Approve the product release label and exact AVR and ESP embedded version pair.
items.evidence: The next unused stable label is v2.0.3; exact source reports ESP 2.35 and AVR 0.210 with resident bootloader BL0.3.

items.description: Confirm the release supports only FlexFox Ver 2.1 (Mar 2022).
items.evidence: The manifest, package README, release notes, and release record state FlexFox Ver 2.1 (Mar 2022) only.

items.description: Freeze and record the exact clean source commit used for both release builds.
items.evidence: Both release build passes and the package manifest use commit 332d9a37fceeea1da192118616b803096090d704.

items.description: Run the full repository check at the frozen source commit.
items.evidence: just check passed on development and integrated main, including clone, firmware-contract, web, documentation, policy, and EEPROM checks; the complete-history secret scan found no leaks.

items.description: Build AVR Release firmware twice with pinned tools and record matching hashes, warnings, resources, and EEPROM ABI.
items.evidence: Two AVR-GCC 7.3.0 / AVR-Dx_DFP 1.9.103 legacy, relocated, and BL0.3 builds were warning-free and byte-identical. Application HEX SHA-256 ae482773e00cfd87039586b3e1890e595e9e501b9179ecb4df1ac698655f3092; text 42806, data 1156, BSS 1585; EEPROM 274 bytes.

items.description: Build the ESP sketch twice with the qualified profile and record matching sketch hashes, warnings, and resources.
items.evidence: Two ESP8266 core 2.7.4 / WebSockets 2.3.6 / LittleFS 2.5.1 HUZZAH 80 MHz 4M1M builds were warning-free and byte-identical. Sketch SHA-256 3e3817c2b60e2f8b94d4cb40ff2fcb6360cf5db80404e295af1114d634749acb; sketch 581120 bytes; IRAM 27676 bytes; dynamic-memory headroom 27608 bytes.

items.description: Generate the release manifest, checksums, package README, and exact AVR, ESP, and LittleFS artifact set.
items.evidence: The exact seven-file v2.0.3 ZIP contains both AVR HEX paths, ESP 2.35 sketch, recovery LittleFS, flexfox80-release-info-v1 manifest, checksum list, and operator README.

items.description: Independently validate manifest fields, package contents, file sizes, and SHA-256 hashes.
items.evidence: A clean extraction passed ZIP integrity, exact inventory, internal SHA-256 checks, build equality, manifest checks, AVR parsing, ESP checksum validation, and LittleFS inventory. ZIP SHA-256 f28e95f19dcfff510bb486e2d073c0458f6e822ef6fc386567d38ef14f6a3b63.

items.description: Complete the versioned FlexFox hardware checklist, recording every approved skip explicitly.
items.evidence: hardware-disposition.md records both masters and all 15 targets, full acceptance on 14 hardware-capable targets, and November's explicit known Linkbus hardware-fault exclusion.

items.description: Install the selected pair on a representative unit and capture the expected combined AVR and ESP version report.
items.evidence: Live fleet probes during the completed rollout reported SW_VERSIONS,2.35,0.210.

items.description: Select and verify the release rollback package and recovery instructions.
items.evidence: rollback.md selects independently verified v2.0.2 as the rollback point and records wireless, programmer, EEPROM/fuse, LittleFS, offset, and verification boundaries.

items.description: Approve concise maintainer notes that separate changes, verification, compatibility, and deferrals.
items.evidence: The owner requested the full release; release-notes.md records clone corrections, compatibility, exact hardware acceptance, and installation boundaries.

items.description: Obtain explicit approval to integrate the candidate into main.
items.evidence: The owner's request to release the pushed clean Development_AVR128DA48 candidate authorized its fast-forward integration into main.

items.description: Verify the clean integrated main commit and reproduce the selected release artifacts from it.
items.evidence: main was fast-forwarded without a merge commit to exact source 332d9a37fceeea1da192118616b803096090d704 and pushed; the full repository suite passed there.

items.description: Obtain explicit approval for the maintenance release, tag, and designated durable archive.
items.evidence: The owner's request explicitly authorized the established full stable GitHub release workflow.

items.description: Create and push an annotated release tag pointing to the verified release commit.
items.evidence: Remote annotated tag object 2dbaac444e55c7eaba3aebb203fd66d5d3dc7f6f peels to exact release source 332d9a37fceeea1da192118616b803096090d704.

items.description: Create a durable maintainer release record with the approved notes and verification summary.
items.evidence: The latest stable, non-draft, non-prerelease GitHub release was published at https://github.com/OpenARDF/FlexFox80/releases/tag/v2.0.3 on 2026-09-04 UTC.

items.description: Store the validated release ZIP and individually required firmware assets in the designated durable archive.
items.evidence: GitHub contains the validated ZIP, both AVR HEX files, ESP sketch, recovery LittleFS, manifest, and checksum list; GitHub-reported sizes and SHA-256 digests match the local set.

items.description: Copy and independently verify the archived assets, hashes, release record, and tag target.
items.evidence: Docs/Software/Evidence/V2_0_3_GITHUB_RELEASE_VERIFICATION_2026-09-03.md records fresh download, byte equality, clean ZIP extraction, image checks, LittleFS radio.html inventory, and remote tag verification.
